headline: Approved July meeting minutes; reviewed Administrative Plan draft and delinquent loan accounts.
summary: The committee approved the July minutes, discussed interest rate language edits, and reviewed sections 1-3 of the Administrative Plan draft, assigning revisions to members. They also reviewed the status of 7 delinquent loan accounts, noting negotiations with Evolution Barbershop and San Francisco Kitchen.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to Approve was made by Christine, seconded by Lyn, all in favor; approved.

plain_text:
Minutes for GNRLF Meeting 
8/31/26 – noon  
Room 208, Nashua City Hall 
 
 
Attending Committee Members: David Dearborn, Dawn Enwright (12:13), Christine Malloy, Stephen Michon, 
Lyn Tripp. Administration: Abimana Ngira, Kathleen Palmer. Absent: Liz Hannum.  
 
Call to Order: 12:06 pm. 
Approval of Minutes: for July. Motion to Approve was made by Christine, seconded by Lyn, all in favor; 
approved. 
Interest rate update: Stephen and Abimana tweaked the language for clarity; Abimana will send it to the 
team. 
Administrative Plan update: A draft was given to the team, who discussed Part I, The Revolving Loan Fund 
Strategy, sections 1-3. Edits and additions were suggested, as well as items that need further research and 
clarification. Abimana and Liz will revise section 1, Dave and Christine will revise section 2. Section 3 had the 
most edits and clarification needed. Abimana will look for a best example from another RLF for modeling. 
RLF portfolio update: 
• The 7 delinquent accounts were sent certified mail letters. A few have responded. 
• Evolution Barbershop and San Francisco Kitchen have come to the table to negotiate; will be asked to 
provide the same data (akin to SyAM process), and to continue monthly temporary good-faith 
payments. Lyn/Dawn are willing to reevaluate past payments being applied to principal instead of 
interest. 
Meeting Adjourned at 1:30 pm.  
Next meeting: Noon Monday, Sept. 21, in Room 208.
